places.name: Seville Cathedral & Giralda Tower
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this Gothic cathedral and bell tower offer stunning views and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during religious services.

places.place_tip: Climb the Giralda Tower for panoramic views.
places.address: Av. de la Constitución, s/n, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Real Alcázar of Seville
places.ai_summary: A stunning royal palace with a mix of Islamic and Christian architecture, surrounded by lush gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.
places.address: Patio de Banderas, s/n, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Plaza de España
places.ai_summary: A magnificent square with a large fountain, bridges, and a semi-circular building, representing the Spanish Renaissance Revival style.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride in the canal for a unique view of the square.
places.address: Pl. de España, 41013 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Maria Luisa Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and expansive park, perfect for a leisurely stroll, with gardens, fountains, and monuments.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 22:00, but visitors can exit at any time.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Plaza de España located within the park.
places.address: Av. de la Borbolla, 41013 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Metropol Parasol (Las Setas)
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural marvel in the old quarter of Seville, offering a panoramic terrace and an archaeological museum.
places.cost: Entry fee required for the terrace

opening_hours.notes: Last admission to the terrace is one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop terrace for breathtaking views of the city.
places.address: Pl. de la Encarnación, s/n, 41003 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Barrio Santa Cruz
places.ai_summary: The old Jewish quarter of Seville, known for its narrow streets, whitewashed buildings, and lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot, be wary of pickpockets.

places.place_tip: Visit the Casa de Pilatos and the Hospital de los Venerables.
places.address: Barrio Santa Cruz, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Plaza de Toros de la Maestranza
places.ai_summary: One of the most important bullrings in Spain, showcasing the traditional Andalusian style.
places.cost: Entry fee required for the museum and guided tours

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for any bullfights or events.
places.address: Paseo de Cristóbal Colón, 22, 41001 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Torre del Oro
places.ai_summary: A 13th-century military watchtower, now a maritime museum, offering great views of the Guadalquivir River.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for a panoramic view of the city and river.
places.address: Paseo de Cristóbal Colón, 22, 41001 Sevilla, Spain

attribution.description: Logotipo del Metro de Sevilla, en pruebas desde octubre de 2024.

places.name: Archivo de Indias
places.ai_summary: A historical building housing important documents related to the Spanish colonies in the Americas.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the exhibition on the Casa de Contratación.
places.address: Av. de la Constitución, s/n, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Triana District
places.ai_summary: A vibrant neighborhood across the river, known for its traditional pottery, flamenco culture, and lively tapas bars.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot, especially the Callejón de la Inquisición.

places.place_tip: Visit the Mercado de Triana for local food and crafts.
places.address: Triana, 41010 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Isla Mágica Theme Park
places.ai_summary: A fun-filled theme park with rides, shows, and attractions for all ages, located on an island in the Guadalquivir River.

opening_hours.notes: Open seasonally, check the website for details.

places.place_tip: Try to visit on a weekday to avoid large crowds.
places.address: Isla de la Cartuja, s/n, 41092 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Hospital de los Venerables
places.ai_summary: A baroque masterpiece, this former hospital is now a cultural center and art gallery.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the stunning ceiling frescoes in the main chapel.
places.address: C. Javier Lasso de la Vega, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

attribution.title: Anuncio del hotel

places.name: Casa de Pilatos
places.ai_summary: A beautiful example of an Andalusian palace, combining Gothic, Mudejar, Renaissance, and Baroque styles.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful gardens and the impressive collection of Roman sculptures.
places.address: C. de los Venerables, 8, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Museo de Bellas Artes de Sevilla
places.ai_summary: The finest art museum in Seville, featuring works from the medieval period to the early 20th century.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on Mondays, but reservation is required.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the works of Murillo and Velázquez.
places.address: Pl. del Museo, 9, 41001 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Alameda de Hércules
places.ai_summary: A lively public square with a bohemian atmosphere, known for its tapas bars and nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the nightlife.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden tapas bars and local music.
places.address: Alameda de Hércules, 41002 Sevilla, Spain

places.name: Monasterio de la Cartuja
places.ai_summary: A former monastery turned into a contemporary art center, located in a tranquil park.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the contemporary art exhibitions and the peaceful gardens.
places.address: Ctra. de la Cartuja, s/n, 41092 Sevilla, Spain

places.ai_summary: A stunning basilica known for its elaborate altar and the revered statue of Our Lady of Hope.

places.ai_summary: A historic tobacco factory, now home to the University of Seville, featuring impressive architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for any university events or exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the Plaza de la Universidad and the surrounding area.
places.address: C. San Fernando, 4, 41004 Sevilla, Spain

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is highly recommended.

places.place_tip: Try the signature 4 bath circuit for a complete experience.

places.ai_summary: A scenic walk along the river, offering beautiful views of the city and its bridges.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Start at the Torre del Oro and walk towards the Triana Bridge.
